=={{header|ghul}}==

<syntaxhighlight lang="ghul">
use IO.Std.write_line;
use Collections;
use Ghul.Pipes;

sieve(limit: int) -> List[int] is
    let composite = LIST();

    (0::limit) |> each(_ => composite.add(false));

    let p mut = 2;

    while p * p <= limit do
        if !composite[p] then
            let multiple mut = p * p;

            while multiple <= limit do
                composite[multiple] = true;
                multiple = multiple + p;
            od
        fi

        p = p + 1;
    od

    return 
        (2::limit) 
            |> filter(i => !composite[i]) 
            |> collect();
si

for p in sieve(100) do
    write_line("{p}");
od
</syntaxhighlight>
